cells.gaps: No source from the last three years naming a public body, system or product tested, audited or certified against the standards is held.
cells.note: The 2018 arrêté adopts the RGI, a normative set of exchange protocols (BFA-001), and the platforms decree makes respect of it a condition of putting a platform into service (BFA-002), a yes to question 3 under the study's rule. Stage 5 needs a system checked against the RGI in the last three years, and none is held.
